description: Golden query set for the IPP sermon corpus. Each query names the sermon ids a good result list must surface. Anchored on real sermons in the indexed corpus, not invented ones. This is what proves the API-only rewrite retrieves as well as the GPU system it replaces.

queries.why: exact topical match; the sermon title says it outright
book plus a phrase from the passage; spans two sermons in the series

UNACCENTED query against accented transcripts -- exercises pt_unaccent. Expectation corrected: the Efésios 2.8-10 sermon on the five solas was originally listed here, but it has zero chunks mentioning justificação, so requiring it would have meant tuning the search to satisfy a wrong label.
single proper noun; the case pure vector search handles worst
topic word plus a paraphrase of it
inflected forms; must stem to igrej/brig and return something rather than nothing
latin phrase mixed with unaccented portuguese

filtered search must still return a full result list. A predicate applied after the RRF fusion instead of inside each arm returns 0-2 here and raises no error -- this is the only gate that catches it.
service-type filter narrows to Sunday school without starving the candidate pool
preacher filter composes with a query that already ranks well unfiltered
